methodologyNotes: Pricing fetched directly from each vendor's official pricing page via WebFetch on 2026-06-14. 7shifts' official pricing page (7shifts.com/pricing) rendered JS-only with no extractable content; prices for 7shifts were taken from two independent aggregators: GetApp and SoftwareAdvice (both corroborating $39.99/$69.99/$149.99/mo flat and a free Comp tier). Homebase annual-discount rate: official site shows $30→$24 monthly (20% off), corroborated by GetApp stating '20% discount'. Sling annual-discount rate: official site states 15% savings. All monthlyUsd values reflect the lowest recurring per-billing-cycle amount (annualized monthly rate where annual billing is the basis). Per-seat products use billingModel=per_seat; per-location flat products use billingModel=flat; quote-only tiers use billingModel=custom with monthlyUsd=null. minutesIncluded, callsIncluded, overagePerMin, overagePerCall are null throughout (non-telephony vertical). hipaa/baa set to null unless explicitly stated on the vendor site. bilingual set to null throughout.

vendors.name: When I Work
vendors.provenance: Official pricing page: https://wheniwork.com/pricing fetched 2026-06-14. Three-tier structure (Essentials/Pro/Premium at $2.50/$5.00/$8.00 per user/month) confirmed. Aggregators (GetApp, SoftwareAdvice) show an older two-tier structure; official page is authoritative.

plans.name: Essentials
plans.notes: Per user per month. Includes auto-scheduling, templates, multi-week/location scheduling, forecasting, in-app messaging, shift swapping. Annual billing available per official page but discount percentage not published.

plans.name: Pro
plans.notes: Per user per month. Adds advanced scheduling rules, permissions, labor sharing, custom forecasting, callout reporting, custom reports, timezone toggling.

plans.name: Premium
plans.notes: Per user per month. Adds API access, webhooks, SAML/SSO on top of Pro.

limits: No free forever plan — 14-day trial only
API access and webhooks restricted to Premium tier ($8/user/mo)
SAML/SSO requires Premium tier
